title: Add all past and current developers to the POM as well as contributors file.
body:
For now im just adding my own name to the pom and contributors file as a developer. We need to add all past developers however to ensure they get credit. The example line in the pom is as follows:

```
    <developers>
        <developer>
            <id>JeffreyPhillipsFreeman</id>
            <name>Jeffrey Phillips Freeman</name>
            <email>Jeffrey.Freeman@Syncleus.com</email>
            <url>http://JeffreyFreeman.me</url>
            <organization>Syncleus</organization>
            <organizationUrl>http://www.syncleus.com</organizationUrl>
            <roles>
                <role>Chief Technology Officer</role>
                <role>Project Owner</role>
                <role>Developer</role>
            </roles>
            <timezone>-5</timezone>
        </developer>
    </developers>
```
author: Participant 1

comments.body: @automenta The contact information added to the CONTRIBUTING file was placed there by automatically extracing it from the git log and placing it there. Your information can not be removed from git history since it is in the git logs itself and placed there by you. We can of course remove it from the CONTRIBUTING file, and im happy to do so, but just pointing out it is just redisplaying information about you that you yourself originally submited.
